title: MeepoGame
description: This is aim trainer with Meepo from Dota 2!
body:
# Train your aim whit fun!
It is mini-game where you can training your aim and get rid of boredom! It's aim trainer for you and great opportunity for improve your skills.
  In 2020 in Dota 2 was mini-game with Meepo and after this I watned to make from this mod in minecraft.
